requirements.title: Worktree creation defaults to inline mode
requirements.body: When the worktree plugin creates a git worktree via worktree_create, it must default to inline mode: no new terminal or tmux window is opened. The agent continues in the same session, using the returned worktree path as workdir for all subsequent tool calls. Projects can opt out by setting "inline": false in .opencode/worktree.jsonc.

scenarios.title: Inline worktree creation returns path for workdir usage
given: The worktree plugin has inline: true (default)
The agent calls worktree_create and it succeeds
then: No new terminal window or tmux window is opened
The tool returns the worktree path
The agent uses the returned path as workdir for all subsequent tool calls
The agent does not emit tmux navigation hints

scenarios.title: Inline mode documentation is consistent across all sources
given: adv-apply.md in the ADV repo contains the worktree creation protocol
ADV_INSTRUCTIONS.md in the ADV repo contains the inline worktree protocol
skills/worktree/SKILL.md in openchad contains the inline mode section
README.md in openchad contains the Worktree Flow section
scenarios.when: The inline mode guidance is compared across all four sources
then: All sources describe inline mode as the default behavior
All sources instruct the agent to use the returned path as workdir
No source references tmux navigation hints as part of the default flow

requirements.title: Worktree inline mode is documented in openchad user-facing docs
requirements.body: openchad must document worktree inline mode behavior in both the worktree skill (skills/worktree/SKILL.md) and the user-facing README.

scenarios.title: worktree skill contains Inline Mode section
given: config/opencode/skills/worktree/SKILL.md exists in the openchad repo
then: A section titled 'Inline Mode (Default)' is present
The section describes that no new terminal is opened
The section instructs using the returned path as workdir

scenarios.title: README.md contains Worktree Flow section
given: README.md exists in the openchad repo
then: A section titled 'Worktree Flow' is present
The section describes inline mode as the default behavior
